"""Conditional current-AP visibility replay; never feeds native truth to control."""
import hashlib,json,math
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from multi_robot_exploration import control
ros=Path.cwd();snapshots=ros/'log/p3b5/p3b5_v38_fixed_lab101_ap_snapshots_qos_fixed/snapshots.jsonl'
ledger=ros/'log/p2d_baseline/p3b5_v38_fixed_lab101/episodes/p3b5_v38_fixed_lab101_lab_far_northwest_3r_seed101_ledger.jsonl'
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in snapshots.open()]
result={'scope':'Conditional component replay on preceding saved received-map/target snapshots; not exact original coordinator buffers, actual detection or mission proof','frozen_commit':'2786b14745591a7dc8adce6f8e52e82cdac0e8ad','source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'snapshot_sha256':hashlib.sha256(snapshots.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'ledger_sha256':hashlib.sha256(ledger.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'cases':[]}
for event in map(json.loads,ledger.open()):
 if event['event']!='coordinator_navigation_decision' or event.get('kind')!='rally':continue
 prior=[x for x in rows if x['observer_time']<=event['event_time'] and 'target_detection' in x['messages']]
 if not prior:continue
 row=prior[-1];m=row['messages'];d=json.loads(m['target_detection']['data']);info=m['map']['info']
 grid=np.asarray(m['map']['data'],dtype=np.int16).reshape(info['height'],info['width'])
 origin=(info['origin']['position']['x'],info['origin']['position']['y']);point=event['requested_position'];target=(d['target_x'],d['target_y'])
 visible=control.rally_target_view(grid,info['resolution'],origin,point,target,d['max_distance_m']-control.NAVIGATION_POSITION_TOLERANCE_M)
 if not visible:continue
 bearing=math.atan2(target[1]-point[1],target[0]-point[0]);error=abs(math.atan2(math.sin(bearing-event['requested_yaw']),math.cos(bearing-event['requested_yaw'])))
 item={'robot':event['robot'],'goal_time':event['event_time'],'snapshot_time':row['observer_time'],'position':point,'requested_yaw':event['requested_yaw'],'bearing_to_delivered_target':bearing,'nominal_camera_angle_error':error,'camera_half_fov':math.radians(d['field_of_view_deg'])/2,'nav_yaw_tolerance':control.NAVIGATION_YAW_TOLERANCE_RAD,'current_map_visibility':True,'actual_confirmation_required':True}
 item['old_heading_guarantees_fov_with_nav_yaw_tolerance']=error+control.NAVIGATION_YAW_TOLERANCE_RAD<=item['camera_half_fov']
 result['cases'].append(item)
assert result['cases']
Path('/tmp/p3b5_v38_observation_heading_replay.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result['cases'],indent=2))
